notes: v0.84.0 (versionCode 121) — CI android-release run 39649484624 from main at e35e2f34. ICONS THAT ACTUALLY DRAW, ILLUSTRATIONS ON BOTH PLATFORMS, EVERY CHART TAPPABLE. (0) THE INVISIBLE-ICON ROOT CAUSE: the generator attribute regex excluded digits, so x1/y1/x2/y2 never matched and every <line>-based Lucide glyph (menu, sliders, equals, minus, alignment) became "M0,0 L0,0" — an empty glass tile. The regex now accepts digits, all 540 icons were regenerated with zero no-op paths, and the generator fails instead of committing blank geometry. Verified on the emulator: the drawer Personalization tile and the top-bar menu glyph render. (1) ILLUSTRATIONS: a fourteen-scene hand-drawn set — Bloom, Conversation, Search, Offline, Error, Library, Voice, Success, Privacy, Archive, Notifications, Video, Clarity, Reflection — sharing one light source (upper left), one material (peach glass, white edge, warm shadow) and one motif (the five-petal bloom). Android draws it in ReferenceArt.kt; iOS has a full SwiftUI Canvas port (GsArtwork.swift) and an SF-Symbol→scene map so empty states stop showing a generic orbit. The Home bento now carries real art: silk film cards with a glass aperture, a clarity lens holding a bloom, and a lotus mirrored in still water. (2) CHARTS: every advanced chart resolves a tap to a datum and reports it in a readout line under the plot — box plot, heatmap, treemap, waterfall, candlestick, gantt, sankey, network, force, wordcloud, sunburst, bullet, quadrant, violin, contour, parallel coordinates, dendrogram and depth. Selection never wraps the transcript. (3) DRAWER: the panel top stop was 55%-alpha, so the dashboard greeting ghosted through the brand lockup; it is now an opaque accent-into-surface veil. Mind Guide no longer wraps its title. (4) iOS: conversation options (rename / archive / delete) now exist in the chat top bar, matching Android. (5) REFERENCE CHAT SURFACES: the "…" sheet is now the reference’s row-for-row list — Share Chat, Rename Chat, Chat Details, Export Chat, Clear Chat, Delete Chat, then a full-width Cancel, each with a glass icon tile and a supporting line. Chat Details opens a real page (Android route, iOS sheet) with measured stats — messages, span, response style — plus Model, Chat name, Chat mode and Export. Share and Export hand off the real transcript; Clear truncates the stored messages. (6) HOME opened on the greeting; the reference opens on the thread you were just in. A glass resume card now sits above the greeting with the last message rendered as prose (markdown fences, tables and headings stripped). Verified: android-app 39652806123 (green), android-screens 39654037552 (green, screenshots in download/qa-0.84-*.png), android-release 39656819090 (green, this APK).
knownLimitations: iOS is compile-verified only by ios-native device+simulator builds; there is no iOS screenshot harness yet.
The artwork is vector-only by design — no raster illustrations ship.
Charts read out one datum at a time; there is no multi-select or pinning.
